headline: Bradesco Chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco Picked for Brazil Finance Minister
summary: Bradesco board chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco Cappi has accepted an invitation to serve as Brazil's finance minister in President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's fourth term. Local markets reacted with optimism, with local equity funds and the Brazilian real benefiting.
why: The appointment of a prominent banking executive to head the Ministry of Finance signals potential fiscal pragmatism and shapes investor confidence in Brazilian assets and sovereign debt.

impacts.name: EWZ
impacts.why: Investor optimism surrounding the incoming finance minister boosted expectations for Brazilian equities traded abroad.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The confirmation of Bradesco Chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco as finance minister spurred a positive reaction among local investors who anticipate a pragmatic fiscal approach.
